prior_adjudication.reason: Haun et al. (2011) Study 4 tested only the geocentric-language group (Hai||om) in counterbalanced instructed blocks, whereas Li & Abarbanell (2018) Experiment 1 explicitly separates that Study 4 replication portion (Tseltal instructed N = 32: 16 Ego-to-Geo + 16 Geo-to-Ego) from the extension manipulation adding counterbalanced English blocks (English instructed N = 25: 13 Ego-to-Geo + 12 Geo-to-Ego; total Experiment 1 recruitment N = 85 including 28 open-ended children).
